headline: Brent Crude Plunges 8.6% as White House Links Midterm Losses to Iran War
summary: Brent crude fell $8.94 to $94.66 per barrel, and WTI dropped $8.01 to $88.08, following reports that the White House tied midterm election losses to the Iran conflict.
why: Crude oil is a primary global energy commodity and a key input for transportation, manufacturing, and general inflation, making price swings significant for broad macroeconomic conditions and energy sector equities.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
